tax.text: Gomez sponsored legislation to raise estate taxes on the wealthiest so billionaires cannot pass fortunes to heirs tax-free.
tax.quote: Sponsored the For the 99.5% Act with Senator Bernie Sanders to ensure billionaires can't pass their money onto their children tax-free

wages.text: A former union organizer, Gomez sponsored the PRO Act to make it easier for workers to unionize and bargain for higher wages.
wages.quote: Sponsored the PRO ACT – which restores the right of workers to freely and fairly form a union and bargain for better wages, working conditions and benefits

trade.text: Gomez opposes Trump's tariffs, calling them a tax on working families that raises consumer prices.
trade.quote: Trump's dumb tariffs are nothing more than a tax on working families, raising prices on everything from groceries, clothes and shoes to cars and construction materials.

debt.text: Gomez says he will always fight to protect Social Security and opposes cuts to Medicare and Medicaid.
debt.quote: I will always fight to protect Social Security--no matter who holds office.

housing.text: Gomez founded and chairs the Congressional Renters Caucus to expand rental assistance and boost housing supply.
housing.quote: Founded and chairs the first ever Congressional Renters Caucus to increase rental assistance, boost the supply of rental housing

immigration.text: The son of immigrants, Gomez frames immigration and diversity as strengths of the country.
immigration.quote: As the son of immigrants, Jimmy Gomez knows that immigration and diversity contribute to the fabric of our country

guns.text: Gomez joined over 200 House Democrats urging the Senate to pass background-check and gun-safety legislation.
guns.quote: Any delay to pass commonsense gun violence prevention legislation only increases the chances that more innocent people in America may suffer from the tragic and needless loss caused by gun violence

gender.text: Gomez denounced federal legislation that would require school sports eligibility to be based on sex at birth.
gender.quote: Today, Rep. Jimmy Gomez (CA-34) denounced House Passage of H.R. 734, the so-called “Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.”

cannabis.text: Gomez cosponsors the MORE Act to deschedule marijuana federally.
cannabis.quote: Cosponsor of the MORE Act to deschedule marijuana as a controlled substance

health.text: Gomez is a founding member of the Medicare for All Caucus and fights to pass Medicare for All.
health.quote: That's why he fights to pass Medicare for All, so no one goes without health care.

energy.text: Gomez championed Inflation Reduction Act provisions projected to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions by 40 percent by 2030.
energy.quote: The Inflation Reduction Act represents the single largest investment in climate action in American history.

voting.text: Gomez cosponsors the Freedom to Vote Act to expand voter registration and access.
voting.quote: Cosponsor of the Freedom to Vote Act to expand voting registration and access

wages.text: She supports stronger protections for gig workers along with expanded leave and childcare support.
wages.quote: stronger protections for gig workers, expanded leave and childcare support

housing.text: She pledges to build permanently affordable housing and expand rental assistance to address homelessness.
housing.quote: building permanently affordable housing that puts people over profit

schools.text: She calls for fully funding public schools, canceling student debt, and tuition-free public college.
schools.quote: from fully funding early childhood and special education to canceling student debt and making public college tuition-free

immigration.text: She supports an inclusive pathway to citizenship for undocumented residents, including DACA recipients, TPS holders and essential workers.
immigration.quote: Angela supports comprehensive immigration reform that includes a clear, attainable, and inclusive pathway to citizenship for the over 11 million undocumented people living in the United States.

health.text: Gonzales-Torres says she supports Medicare for All and calls health care a human right, backing expanded public coverage.
health.quote: Angela is fighting to make that a reality by co-sponsoring Medicare for All, investing in mental health and addiction care

energy.text: She advocates a Green New Deal prioritizing renewable energy and green jobs to cut emissions.
energy.quote: Angela is fighting for a bold, community-driven Green New Deal that prioritizes renewable energy, unionized green jobs
